tagline.en: Seventy-six miles that took a generation to negotiate
tagline.zh: 七十六英里，谈了整整一代人

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 弗吉尼亚州米德尔敦附近，与 I-81 相接

end.zh: 华盛顿特区，与 US 29 相接

en: I-66 is short, entirely eastern, and shaped more by argument than by terrain. It begins at I-81 in the Shenandoah Valley, crosses the Blue Ridge at Front Royal, and then runs east through Fauquier and Prince William counties into the Washington suburbs, ending a mile inside the District at a set of ramps by the Potomac.

The outer half is a conventional commuter Interstate, now carrying two tolled express lanes in each direction alongside three free ones. The inner half is unlike anything else in the system: four lanes, no heavy trucks at any hour, tolls or a three-person carpool required in the peak direction at peak times, and the Washington Metro Orange Line running in the median for much of the way through Arlington.
Those restrictions are not traffic-management decisions taken later. They are the terms on which the road was allowed to exist, written into a federal approval in 1977 and still in force.
zh: I-66 很短，完全位于东部，其形态更多由争论而非地形塑造。它起自谢南多厄河谷的 I-81，在弗朗特罗亚尔翻越蓝岭，随后向东穿过福基尔县和威廉王子县进入华盛顿郊区，在特区境内一英里处、波托马克河畔的一组匝道上结束。
外侧一半是常规的通勤型州际公路，如今每个方向有两条收费快速车道，与三条免费车道并行。内侧一半则与系统中任何道路都不同：四车道、全天禁止重型卡车、高峰时段高峰方向必须缴费或乘员达三人，而且华盛顿地铁橙线在阿灵顿境内大部分路段就走在中央分隔带上。
这些限制并非事后采取的交通管理措施。它们是这条路获准存在的条件，1977 年写进了一份联邦批准文件，至今仍然有效。

en: Virginia began buying right-of-way through Arlington in the early 1960s, first for six lanes and from 1965 for eight, with the road planned to feed a new Three Sisters Bridge across the Potomac and the District's Inner Loop freeways. Arlington residents sued; in 1971 the case reached federal court, and by 1974 the District Council had shelved the bridge and the freeway plans behind it.

The proposal shrank in stages — eight lanes, then six, then rejection. The Federal Highway Administration disapproved a six-lane design in 1975, and Transportation Secretary William Coleman said he would not approve the project as presented. Virginia came back with four lanes and a list of concessions, and in January 1977 Coleman approved it, calling it one of the hardest decisions of his tenure. His successor Brock Adams reaffirmed the approval a month later, conceding openly that the highway was the price the governor of Virginia had exacted for finishing Metro in the state.
Construction began in August 1977. Virginia's share of the cancelled bridge money went to Metro instead, and the transit line was built in the highway median as the highway was built around it.
zh: 弗吉尼亚州自 1960 年代初开始在阿灵顿收购路权，最初按六车道，1965 年起按八车道，规划中这条路要接上一座新建的「三姐妹桥」跨越波托马克河，并连通特区的内环高速网。阿灵顿居民提起诉讼；1971 年案件进入联邦法院，到 1974 年，特区议会已经搁置了这座桥及其背后的高速公路规划。
方案分阶段缩水——八车道，然后六车道，然后被否决。联邦公路管理局 1975 年否决了六车道设计，运输部长威廉·科尔曼表示不会批准当时提交的项目。弗吉尼亚改为四车道并附上一串让步条件，1977 年 1 月科尔曼予以批准，称这是他任内最艰难的决定之一。一个月后，继任者布罗克·亚当斯重申了这项批准，并公开承认：这条公路是弗吉尼亚州长为换取本州地铁建成而索取的代价。
工程于 1977 年 8 月动工。弗吉尼亚在那座被取消的桥梁上应分摊的资金转给了地铁，轨道线就建在公路的中央分隔带里，公路则围着它一并建成。

en: The 1977 approval covered a highway whose cost was reported at the time in the low hundreds of millions. Four decades later the state spent an order of magnitude more to add capacity beside it, and did so without putting public construction money in.

The Transform 66 Outside the Beltway project was let as a fifty-year concession in 2016. A private consortium financed, designed and built two express lanes in each direction over twenty-two and a half miles, rebuilt the general-purpose lanes, and paid the Commonwealth an upfront concession fee on top. Virginia offered a public subsidy; the consortium did not take it. The lanes opened ahead of schedule in November 2022.
zh: 1977 年的批准所涉及的这条公路，当时报道的造价在数亿美元的低位区间。四十年后，州政府在其旁边增设通行能力所花的钱高出一个数量级，而且没有动用公共建设资金。
「改造 66 号」环城路以外段项目于 2016 年以五十年特许经营方式发包。一家私营财团出资、设计并建成了二十二点五英里内每个方向各两条的快速车道，重建了普通车道，还额外向州政府支付了一笔前期特许权费。弗吉尼亚曾提出公共补贴；财团没有接受。这些车道于 2022 年 11 月提前通车。

value.zh: 75.78 英里——弗吉尼亚州 74.77 英里，哥伦比亚特区 1.01 英里

value.en: Reported at $170 million when the approval was reaffirmed
value.zh: 批准获重申时报道的造价为 1.7 亿美元

value.en: $3.7 billion of private investment over 22.5 miles, including $2.3 billion of design and construction and a $579 million upfront concession payment; a matching public subsidy was offered and declined
value.zh: 22.5 英里范围内的私人投资 37 亿美元，其中设计施工 23 亿美元，前期特许权费 5.79 亿美元；政府曾提出等额补贴，被拒绝

figures.source: Virginia Department of Transportation, I-66 Express Lanes opening release, 22 November 2022; 66 Express Outside the Beltway project FAQ

why.en: No single public figure covers the route. The original highway was built in the late 1970s and early 1980s under federal aid accounted for by state and fiscal year, the express lanes outside the Beltway were privately financed under a separate concession, and the tolling conversion inside the Beltway was a third project.
why.zh: 没有单一的公开数字涵盖整条路线。最初的公路建于 1970 年代末至 1980 年代初，所用联邦补助按州和财政年度核算；环城路以外的快速车道由私人依另一份特许协议融资；环城路以内的收费化改造则是第三个项目。

timeline.en: I-66 is added to the Interstate System on 14 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 14 日，I-66 被纳入州际公路系统。

timeline.en: Arlington residents' challenge to the highway reaches federal court; right-of-way for eight lanes has already been bought through the county.
timeline.zh: 阿灵顿居民对这条公路的诉讼进入联邦法院；此时穿越该县的八车道路权已经购妥。

timeline.en: The Federal Highway Administration disapproves a six-lane design, and the Transportation Secretary declines to approve the project as presented.
timeline.zh: 联邦公路管理局否决六车道设计，运输部长拒绝批准当时提交的方案。

timeline.en: Secretary Coleman approves a four-lane highway in January with peak-direction carpool rules, a permanent heavy-truck ban and Metro in the median. Construction begins on 8 August.
timeline.zh: 1 月，科尔曼部长批准一条四车道公路，条件包括高峰方向合乘规则、永久禁止重型卡车，以及地铁设于中央分隔带。8 月 8 日动工。

timeline.en: Dynamically tolled express lanes begin operating inside the Beltway on 4 December, using the existing roadway.
timeline.zh: 12 月 4 日，环城路以内利用既有路面开始运营动态收费快速车道。

timeline.en: The 22.5-mile express lanes outside the Beltway open fully on 22 November; the carpool exemption inside the Beltway rises to three occupants on 5 December.
timeline.zh: 11 月 22 日，环城路以外 22.5 英里快速车道全线开通；12 月 5 日，环城路以内的免费合乘门槛提高到三人。
